what: A stack of white rounded menu cards: hovering a card slides it 10px right in .25s, and a 12px color band hidden outside the left edge (−20px) slides in over .15s to paint the card’s left edge. The current page card (aria-current · .is-active) always stays shifted with the band — with look: point the band takes the accent color (a branch marker such as charity care)

options.look: if point, the band uses the accent color

use:
• HOME
  • Menu

from.where: index.html .gu-nav__item.is-line — original .p-nav__list__item:hover translateX(10px), transition transform .25s, ::before 12px #2C4680 translate(−20px→0) .15s, -is-active always shifted, -point is an orange band

note: Hover reactions are applied only on devices that support hover (the original kept :hover on touch too)
